necc_primary.label: Small-cell neuroendocrine carcinoma of cervix: NECC-specific workup and stage-directed multimodality primary treatment.

recommendation.title: Small-cell neuroendocrine carcinoma of cervix: NECC-specific workup and stage-directed multimodality primary treatment.

options.label: NECC-specific treatment
options.text: Use systemic therapy with surgery/RT according to stage and source algorithm.

necc_la.label: Locally advanced small-cell NECC: systemic therapy plus definitive RT/brachytherapy pathway.

recommendation.title: Locally advanced small-cell NECC: systemic therapy plus definitive RT/brachytherapy pathway.

options.label: Multimodality treatment
options.text: Use NECC systemic therapy and definitive radiation/brachytherapy per source.

phase_inc.label: Incidental invasive cancer after simple/total hysterectomy?

post_highrisk.label: Post-radical surgery with positive nodes/margin/parametrium: adjuvant chemoradiation field/intensity based on distant disease and nodal distribution.

recommendation.title: Post-radical surgery with positive nodes/margin/parametrium: adjuvant chemoradiation field/intensity based on distant disease and nodal distribution.

options.label: Adjuvant chemoradiation
options.text: Use pelvic/extended-field RT + concurrent platinum as source-defined; add brachytherapy when indicated.

options.label: If distant metastases
options.text: Transition to metastatic systemic treatment pathway.

post_intermediate.label: Post-radical surgery node/margin/parametrium negative: observe or use pelvic RT based on Sedlis/intermediate risk factors.

recommendation.title: Post-radical surgery node/margin/parametrium negative: observe or use pelvic RT based on Sedlis/intermediate risk factors.

options.label: Observation
options.text: When no source-defined adjuvant risk indication.

options.label: Pelvic EBRT
options.text: When combination of risk factors meets source criteria; concurrent chemotherapy only in source-defined circumstances.

incidental.label: Incidental cervical carcinoma after simple/total hysterectomy: stage/pathology/margin-directed completion surgery or chemoradiation pathway.

recommendation.title: Incidental cervical carcinoma after simple/total hysterectomy: stage/pathology/margin-directed completion surgery or chemoradiation pathway.

options.label: Completion surgery/nodal assessment
options.text: For source-defined early operable states.

options.label: Definitive/adjuvant chemoradiation
options.text: For positive margins, higher stage, or nonsurgical states.

options.label: Surveillance
options.text: History/physical and clinically indicated imaging/testing; cytology has limited recurrence-detection value.

options.label: Survivorship
options.text: Address sexual health, lymphedema, bone, psychosocial and general survivorship needs.

localrec.label: Locoregional cervical recurrence: salvage surgery and/or radiation based on prior RT, site, and resectability.

recommendation.title: Locoregional cervical recurrence: salvage surgery and/or radiation based on prior RT, site, and resectability.

options.label: Local salvage
options.text: Exenteration/resection and/or definitive RT/chemoradiation when feasible.

options.label: Systemic therapy
options.text: Use when not locally salvageable or with disseminated disease.

met.label: Stage IVB or distant metastatic/recurrent cervical cancer: systemic therapy based on PD-L1/biomarkers/prior treatment, with local palliation as appropriate.

recommendation.title: Stage IVB or distant metastatic/recurrent cervical cancer: systemic therapy based on PD-L1/biomarkers/prior treatment, with local palliation as appropriate.

options.label: First-line systemic therapy
options.text: Use source-preferred platinum/taxane ± bevacizumab with immunotherapy when biomarker/eligibility criteria are met.

options.label: Subsequent therapy
options.text: Use source-listed immunotherapy/ADC/chemotherapy options by biomarkers and prior exposure.

fertility.label: Early cervical cancer with fertility-sparing intent: cone/trachelectomy/nodal staging pathway according to LVSI, margins, stage and conservative-surgery criteria.

recommendation.title: Early cervical cancer with fertility-sparing intent: cone/trachelectomy/nodal staging pathway according to LVSI, margins, stage and conservative-surgery criteria.

options.label: Conservative surgery
options.text: Use cone or trachelectomy/nodal assessment only when source criteria are met.

ia1_nonfert.label: Stage IA1 non-fertility-sparing: margin/LVSI/operability-directed cone or hysterectomy ± nodal assessment.

recommendation.title: Stage IA1 non-fertility-sparing: margin/LVSI/operability-directed cone or hysterectomy ± nodal assessment.

options.label: Surgery
options.text: Type A/B hysterectomy or repeat cone depending on margin/LVSI/operability.

options.label: Brachytherapy/RT
options.text: For medically inoperable source-defined states.

early_conservative.label: Stage IA2-IB1 meeting conservative surgery criteria: less-radical surgery + nodal staging pathway.

recommendation.title: Stage IA2-IB1 meeting conservative surgery criteria: less-radical surgery + nodal staging pathway.

options.label: Conservative surgery
options.text: Use source-defined less-radical hysterectomy/conization strategy with SLN/pelvic nodal assessment as applicable.

early_noncons.label: Stage IB1 not meeting conservative criteria (and selected IB2/IIA1): radical surgery or definitive chemoradiation pathway.

recommendation.title: Stage IB1 not meeting conservative criteria (and selected IB2/IIA1): radical surgery or definitive chemoradiation pathway.

options.label: Radical surgery
options.text: For operable appropriate stage.

options.label: Definitive chemoradiation + brachytherapy
options.text: Alternative/primary option according to stage and patient factors.

bulky.label: Stage IB3/IIA2: definitive chemoradiation + brachytherapy or selected surgical approach per source; completion hysterectomy is not routine.

recommendation.title: Stage IB3/IIA2: definitive chemoradiation + brachytherapy or selected surgical approach per source; completion hysterectomy is not routine.

options.label: Definitive chemoradiation
options.text: Concurrent platinum + EBRT + brachytherapy; stage-appropriate immunotherapy considerations per current source.

options.label: Selected surgery
options.text: Only in appropriate multidisciplinary settings.

locallyadv.label: Stage IIB-IVA cervical cancer: definitive EBRT + concurrent platinum + brachytherapy, with stage/source-defined pembrolizumab integration.

recommendation.title: Stage IIB-IVA cervical cancer: definitive EBRT + concurrent platinum + brachytherapy, with stage/source-defined pembrolizumab integration.

options.label: Definitive chemoradiation + brachytherapy
options.text: Core treatment.

options.label: Immunotherapy integration
options.text: Use stage/source-defined concurrent and maintenance pembrolizumab criteria.

outside.label: Case is outside Cervical cancer ruleset.
